sonnet.problem: This choice card cites verses 11-12, but the story card that tells verse 11 comes after it (card 7), and verse 12 is asked later still (card 8). The choice card jumps ahead of the story it depends on, and the cards then go back to verse 11.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
